preconditions.description: The length of the given ABC-string S is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The given string S contains only characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of substrings of S that have an equal number of 'A'-s, 'B'-s, and 'C'-s.
